title: Break a big task into small steps

body.text: Don't give a complex task all at once —
: the output of one step becomes the input of the next. For example: (1) summarize the article → (2) extract the key points → (3) write posts from those points. Each step is clear and checkable.

example:
Step 1: Summarize this report
Step 2: Extract the 3 standout points
Step 3: Write 3 post captions, one from each point

title: Why it beats one big prompt

body.text: . If one step's output is poor, you fix just that step instead of redoing everything — like an assembly line with quality checks at each point.

example: If the captions miss the mark → go back and sharpen only the 'extract key points' step, no need to start over
